Unknown part numbers produce Unknown (no rated speed to compare). fourDimmIntel: DDR5 with two modules per channel, single-rank, per Intel's datasheets: 13th and 14th gen desktop (743844, SKU support matrix and SAGV points: 2DPC 1R 4000, 2R 3600), Core Ultra 200S (Arrow Lake S, SKU support matrix: 2DIMM 1R 4800, 2R 4400). Checked 2026-10-11.

intelLocked._comment: A.xmp variant intelLocked. Intel ARK: B360, H370 (300 series), B460, H470 (400 series) 'Supports Memory Overclocking: No', Z370, Z390, Z490 'Yes'; Z590 (500 series, also takes 10th gen processors in LGA1200) 'Yes', checked 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-02. Micro-ATX names like Z390M count as Z boards; ASUS ROG Maximus X to XIII are Z370 to Z590 boards whose names carry no chipset. processors: the desktop models of these generations and the memory speed Intel specifies for them, the first match wins; mobile (H, U, Y, G) and X299 (X) models are left out. Intel ARK 'Memory Types', checked 2026-11-02: i3-8100, i3-9100, Pentium Gold G5400, Celeron G4900 DDR4-2400; i5-8400, i7-8700K, i5-9400F, i9-9900K, i3-10100, i5-10400, Pentium Gold G6400, Celeron G5900 DDR4-2666; i7-10700, i9-10900K DDR4-2933.
